summary: Standalone coffee-ship DVA-C03 demo fully meets the task; all local verification (cdk synth, pytest, bash -n, JSON/YAML/hook parse) passes.
findings: Standalone boundary holds: grep for 'applications' and 'session3' across the project returns no matches; nothing is read or imported from the forbidden paths.

Region ap-southeast-1 pinned in infra/bin/coffee-ship.ts, app/samconfig.toml, deploy.sh, destroy.sh, and FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md, and present in both synthesized templates; no second region referenced.

CDK v2 split into NetworkDataStack (VPC public-only/0 NAT, DynamoDB, SQS, SSM param, Secrets Manager, AppConfig app/env/profile/strategy) and AppPipelineStack (ECR+lifecycle, ECS/Fargate+ALB, SNS, alarm, pipeline), pinned aws-cdk-lib 2.160.0; cdk synth exits 0.

Pipeline is S3-source only: synthesized Source action Owner AWS/Provider S3, Build CodeBuild, two S3 deploy actions, Manual approval wired to SNS topic coffee-ship-approval; zero GitHub/CodeCommit matches; five stages Source->Build->Deploy-Test->Approval->Deploy-Prod; source key source.zip in a versioned bucket resolved from stack resources (not hardcoded).

SAM Python 3.12 Lambda with AutoPublishAlias live and DeploymentPreference Canary10Percent5Minutes + CloudWatch alarm coffee-ship-loyalty-errors (AWS/Lambda Errors, threshold 1) for CodeDeploy rollback; API body parsed as STRING, 400 on malformed.

ECS/Fargate confirmed in synth: Cpu 256/Memory 512, DesiredCount 1, MinimumHealthyPercent 100/MaximumPercent 200, DeploymentCircuitBreaker Enable+Rollback true, public subnets assignPublicIp, no NAT; ECR lifecycle keeps 10 images.
AppConfig + SSM parameter (/coffee-ship/loyalty/points-per-dollar) + Secrets Manager secret (coffee-ship/payment-provider-api-key) all present in the synthesized network template.

events/apigw-happy.json and apigw-malformed.json both have STRING bodies; buildspec runs sam validate (guarded) + pytest + documented no-op headless gate (exit 0, annotated fail-on-nonzero); appspec.yaml + taskdef.json present.
Kiro v1 hook valid: version '1', when.type PostFileSave, pattern \.py$, then.type agent (tests-only prompt).

deploy.sh and destroy.sh use set -euo pipefail and pass bash -n; destroy.sh guards all destructive steps behind a typed 'destroy' confirmation; README has cost warning; FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK has five acts + teardown.

Local verification reproduced independently: pytest 5 passed; bash -n clean; container app compiles; all JSON/YAML parse; hook schema OK; cdk synth exits 0 with required constructs present. No AWS deploy attempted.

Non-blocking notes (intentional, documented): SAM and CDK stacks declare name-identical coffee-ship-orders resources (the 'three ways' teaching point); appspec.yaml is an inspectable artifact, not the live canary driver; headless build gate is a no-op until '|| true' is removed; container/app.py has no automated test coverage.
